summary.startupAdjustedVoidReason: P7-20/P7-70: with this suite composition the majority of denominators are at or below the noise band; unresolved cases are never aggregated and the aggregate is therefore not emitted

zjs.provenance: repository commit and dirty state are inferred from the binary realpath; SHA-256 is the authoritative binary identity

qjs.provenance: repository commit and dirty state are inferred from the binary realpath; SHA-256 is the authoritative binary identity

sessions.description: legacy one-process-per-case ABBA path; session mode is off

sampling.orderDescription: Warmup and timed rounds both alternate: zero-based even rounds run qjs then zjs; odd rounds run zjs then qjs. The two engines in each round are adjacent processes.

qjs.reason: Bellard qjs unconditionally frees handlers, context, and runtime before exit

zjs.reason: src/cli/zjs.zig deliberately skips runtime.deinit() on the happy path

lifecycle.comparisonReason: qjs includes teardown while normal zjs intentionally relies on OS process cleanup

validation.mismatchDisposition: invalid and excluded from case and summary statistics

pmu.aggregation: arithmetic mean across individually collected process invocations; each invocation selects exactly one countable PMU row per event, and multiple countable PMUs invalidate that event
pmu.affinityPolicy: perf stat and measured children inherit the outer runner affinity; no measured binary is wrapped in taskset
pmu.unavailableReason: PMU collection disabled; pass --pmu to collect PRD 3.2 instructions-first arbitration metrics
pmu.arbitrationMetricUnavailableReason: instructions were not collected because --pmu was not provided

peakRssKb.aggregation: median across individually collected process invocations
peakRssKb.affinityPolicy: /usr/bin/time and measured children inherit the outer runner affinity; no measured binary is wrapped in taskset

allocations.unavailableReason: allocation count is not exposed by the whole-process runner

allocatedBytes.unavailableReason: allocated bytes are not exposed by the whole-process runner
